Class Transaction

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.model.Transaction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Transaction extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a completed sales transaction with all financial details and customer information. Uses the Builder pattern for flexible transaction creation with various tax and discount strategies. Implements Serializable to support persistence.
